editorial.editorial_summary: Flocksy is a subscription creative-production service, not an email marketing or cold-outreach platform. Plans provide a dedicated multidisciplinary team for design, video, motion, illustration and copy support, with capacity measured in daily creative hours. It suits teams with recurring creative work; its monthly commitment is likely excessive for occasional one-off tasks.
